planSteps.description: Run in the public anonymous environment. Never log in, enter credentials, mutate existing records, or alter auth/storage. Use only unique current-run Standalone timers. Current standard production build and unchanged CSP are required.

Create two own Count Up and two Count Down timers. Manually pause one in each tab, bulk pause running records in that tab, then bulk start both including the manually paused one. Verify the other tab retains its independent state. Never invoke shared bulk.
Up/down controls work independently; manually paused timers resume in their selected tab; unrelated tab state is unchanged.

Allow genuine service-worker installation. Await activated registration AND serviceWorker.ready. Open a genuine subsequent same-origin document and verify navigator.serviceWorker.controller; the initial installation page need not already be controlled. Use standard build only.

Create and pause one own Standalone timer, go offline using supported real browser controls, reload, close the page and reopen same origin offline. Then test /password-login, /account/activate, /account/reset, /account/security and /api/auth/refresh navigation without an app-shell fallback. Inspect CacheStorage: static assets only, no auth/token/personal API responses. Restore network and verify the same paused timer.

Actual offline reload/reopen preserve the local record; sensitive routes fail network rather than authenticated cached success. No helper build/CSP relaxation. If offline/lifecycle/cache inspection is unavailable, BLOCKED, not PASS. Genuine new-release update is separately BLOCKED without a release; do not fabricate one.

Use an existing authorized runtime session without recording credentials. Never alter Telegram registration. If that session cannot be provided safely, cloud BLOCKED; independent browser evidence is separate.

Settings Telegram help: test all steps, labelled dialog with aria-modal, safe close-button initial focus, Tab/Shift+Tab containment, inert background, Escape/close/final Tamam and return focus to opener. Repeat mobile/desktop light/dark.
Every modal state remains keyboard reachable and correctly labelled; closing restores the opener; Telegram binding is unchanged.

Open shared delete confirmation at mobile/desktop light/dark. Native dialog is labelled and aria-modal. Initial focus is Vazgeç, never destructive Sil. Verify focus containment, inert background, Escape/cancel and focus restoration; only explicit own confirmation may delete.

Native dialog semantics/focus work with unchanged Sil/Vazgeç meaning. No shared bulk trigger exists. Shared ConfirmModal personal conflict use retains explicit separate acceptance and disabled confirmation.
